contexts.text: Bone = the proprium not much vivified: flesh = the proprium vivified.
Truth and good vivified by the Lord. Described.
To make seed alive () = the truths of faith. Explained.
Those are said to be made alive who receive the Lord's life. Explained.
The proprium of man, when vivified, is as if blotted out. Signified.
They will kill me, and will make thee live () = that they would not care for celestial things, but only for mere Knowledges.
Celestial love vivifies everything into which it inflows; it even vivifies affections of evil.
What the Word is when the Lord vivifies it... and when He does not vivify it.
The Word is vivified in the reader by the Lord...
How the end is vivified by the life.
To bury = to be vivified, because they are in the course of receiving faith. Explained.
The light of Heaven... then vivifies the things which are of the light of the world...
The things in the Natural are vivified by influx from the Spiritual World.
God sent me before you to make alive () = spiritual life in them by Providence. AC 5898.
That vivification, and to vivify, = spiritual life, that is, new life through regeneration. Explained, Illustrated.
That the Celestial Internal will vivify. Signified, Explained.
The interior things which vivify truth...
Thou hast made us live () = spiritual life no otherwise...
In what precedes, it has treated of the vivification, or regeneration, of the Natural, the whole process being described.
Prediction concerning vivification. Signified, Explained.
Not that the descendants of Jacob were vivified; but those who are in the truth of faith and good of charity.
Vivification by means of the good of charity and the truth of faith. Signified, Explained.
To make to live a great people () = that hence is life for those who are in the truths of good. To make to live = spiritual life. References.
They kept the boys alive () = that truths, being of good, were preserved. To keep alive = to preserve.
It is the spirit that quickeneth ().
All who are being regenerated, are vivified from what is proper to the Lord. Signified.
As (the Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord) is the inmost, it... vivifies the truth which is beneath. Treated of.
The regeneration and vivification of those things which are in the internal and external man. Signified, Explained.

Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live () = [no] deprivation of spiritual life; (for) those deprive themselves of spiritual life who conjoin with the truths of faith falsities from the evil of the love of self. AC 9188:2.
Waving = vivification; for truths are not alive with a man until they are in good.
For (the Lord's Divine celestial good) vivifies all things through the Divine truth which proceeds from it; and it vivifies them according to the quality of the reception.
The Word vivifies those who read it holily.
This spiritual heat... vivifies the knowledges of truth and good...

The spiritual Sun by its heat vivifies spiritual beings... loo, God... through this Proceeding, vivifies and enlightens Angels and men... Therefore, vivification and enlightenment are said to be effected through the Spirit of Jehovah.
The Word, from this life, vivifies the affections of the will of the man who reads it holily. Signified.
He who vivifies all in Heaven and the Church, and each and all things with them. Signified, Explained.
That these two essentials of the New Church ... are vivified by the Lord with those who receive them. Signified, Explained.
Plays, music, etc., are sweetnesses, because they are vivifications.
The life which is the light that proceeds from the spiritual Sun... as it illumines, so it also vivifies, the understanding of man.
That the Divine virtue and operation meant by the Holy Spirit, are, in general, reformation and regeneration; and, according to these... vivification, etc. General article. TCR 149.
Through Divine truth from Good, that is, through faith from charity, man is... vivified, etc.
Thus God, from His life, vivifies every man; and that, without this vivification, man would be, in flesh a mere sponge, and in bones a mere skeleton...
The Divine love as heat, and the Divine wisdom as light, inflow into human minds... and vivify them according to the quality of the form...
This quickening (of vegetation in the spring) may be seen to the life in the Spiritual World.
By the conjunction of (spiritual light and heat) the Lord vivifies and regenerates man.
Consent... vivifies my mind.
Those who are Babel... laboured to vivify (Charles XII).
To make alive the souls that should not live () = to persuade them that eternal life is from falsities.
To keep them alive in famine () = to give spiritual life according to the desire.
